intervention: Lower the retention priority of pre-switch associations after the revision boundary.
endpoint: paired K2 difference (Organica minus the strongest-of-grid baseline) on the ten K2 seeds, with its 98.33% interval
comparator: strongest-of-grid simple baseline, best configuration per seed

decision_threshold.pass: K2 paired difference improves by at least 0.10 relative to the pre-intervention -0.5735 gap, and K1's absolute paired difference changes by no more than 0.05.
decision_threshold.fail: K2 paired difference improves by less than 0.05, or K1's absolute paired difference changes by more than 0.05.
decision_threshold.inconclusive: K2 improvement is between 0.05 and 0.10, or the registration's audit/validity condition fails.

threshold_rule: These are pre-registered provisional thresholds, not values estimated from the intervention run. Improvement is the post-intervention K2 difference minus the baseline_gap.
does_not_allocate: This registration allocates no seed, cell, grant or result; it makes K2 eligible to be in-test.
